entities.name: Alfredo Andersen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alfred Emil Andersen, known as Alfredo was a Norwegian-born painter, sculptor, scenographer and art professor, who spent most of his life in Brazil. He is sometimes referred to as the "Father of painting of Paraná".
